meta.name: baoyu-format-markdown
meta.description: Formats plain text or markdown files with frontmatter, titles, summaries, headings, bold, lists, and code blocks. Use when user asks to "format markdown", "beautify article", "add formatting", or improve article layout. Outputs to {filename}-formatted.md.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给纯文本或 Markdown 文件添加标题、摘要、加粗等格式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常需要快速美化 Markdown 文档的排版
copy.tagline_en: Add titles, summaries, bold, and more to plain text or Markdown files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to quickly beautify Markdown document formatting

howto.what: Claude 会读你指定的文本或 Markdown 文件,分析后补上 frontmatter、标题、摘要、小标题、加粗、列表、代码块等排版,再跑脚本修中英间距与强调符号,输出 {文件名}-formatted.md,不改动原文内容。
howto.when: 当你要求「格式化 markdown」「美化文章」「改进文章排版」等时触发。若文件已有 Markdown 格式,它会先问是优化排版、保留原格式,还是只做排版修正。

say.text: 帮我把 article.md 排版一下
把这段纯文本整理成带小标题和列表的 markdown
say.note: 补 frontmatter、标题、摘要,正文转成结构化排版

say.text: 只修中英文间距和引号,别改结构
say.note: 只跑排版脚本,直接改原文件

howto.what_en: Claude reads your text or Markdown file, adds frontmatter, title, summary, headings, bold, lists and code blocks, runs a script to fix CJK spacing and emphasis, and writes {filename}-formatted.md without changing the content.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to "format markdown", "beautify article" or improve layout. If Markdown formatting already exists, it first asks whether to optimize it, keep it, or only fix typography.

say_en.text: Turn this plain text into Markdown with headings and lists
say_en.note: Adds frontmatter, title, summary, headings and lists

say_en.text: Only fix CJK spacing and quotes, keep the structure
say_en.note: Runs the typography script on the original file
